# Leading Power Apps and Dataverse consultants in Sydney

For custom operational apps serving warehouse staff, shop-floor operators and field teams, I’d prioritise consultancies that can do more than build a Power Apps interface. You want a team that understands **Dataverse data modelling, mobile usability, offline work, barcode or QR scanning, workflow automation, and integration with ERP or inventory systems**\.

Based on current public service descriptions, I’d start with the following shortlist. This is a fit-based assessment, not a definitive industry ranking: the strongest choice depends on whether you need a focused low-code build or a larger business-systems implementation.

## Who I’d contact first

For your particular use case, I’d narrow the initial conversations to three firms\:

| Priority | Consultant | Best reason to engage |
|--------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Inturing | Most explicit alignment with warehouse, shop-floor and field apps using Dataverse |
| 2 | codeSource | Bespoke application development, mobile interfaces and integration |
| 3 | Eagle360 | Operational apps closely connected to ERP and inventory processes |


Inturing is the clearest match on the published evidence: it specifically describes Dataverse-backed operational apps, offline capture, shop-floor readiness and ERP integration. [inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/solutions/business-apps?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[inturing.com.au](https://inturing.com.au/about?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/offline-apps?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What to ask before appointing a consultant

A polished demo isn't enough for an operational system. Ask each firm to demonstrate how it would handle your actual workflow.

- **Dataverse\:** How would you model products, locations, work orders, inventory movements, inspections and users?
- **Warehouse usability\:** Can staff scan barcodes or QR codes, work with gloves on tablets, and minimise typing?
- **Connectivity\:** What happens when Wi-Fi drops in a warehouse, factory or remote field location?
- **Integration\:** How will transactions synchronise with your ERP, inventory platform or manufacturing system without creating duplicate or inconsistent records?
- **Governance\:** How will permissions, audit trails, environments, testing and deployment be managed?
- **Ownership\:** Will you receive the source solution, documentation, deployment process and training to maintain it?

Microsoft documents offline support for Dataverse-based canvas apps, but the consultant should demonstrate that the specific workflow and integrations work under your connectivity conditions. [learn.microsoft.com](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/offline-apps?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Field service, maintenance and site inspections

A broader operational app spanning several teams

Existing ERP or inventory system

Mostly Microsoft 365 and spreadsheets

Starting from scratch

---

3\. Business size

Mid-sized business

Large enterprise or multiple sites
